_comment: The forced-choice menu for the RSCH-1 attacker (see preregistration.md §6.1).
12 options: the 6 true source domains present in the corpus, plus 6 distractors.
The distractors are drawn from husk-api/static/llm-translation-targets.json on
purpose. They are HARD NEGATIVES: a husk translated into 'hotel-booking' will
read like hotel-booking code, so an attacker is tempted toward it. Picking the
TARGET domain instead of the SOURCE domain is exactly the behaviour a working
husk should produce, and a menu without that lure would overstate the attacker's
difficulty. The BLIND arm controls for any resulting bias, since a blind
attacker never sees the target vocabulary.
Option ORDER is permuted per item by a recorded seed. Do not rely on this order.
There is deliberately no 'cannot determine' option - see preregistration.md §6.1.
is_source_domain: true means the corpus contains artifacts labelled with this id
and it can be a correct answer. false means it is a distractor and never correct.
